description:
One search hook replaces the local scorer and guards stale responses.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Browser uses server issue and linked-document matches, preserves navigation, and ignores stale in-flight results after query or version changes; the App passes its SSE version to the hook and routes issue matches to issue details and document matches to the viewer. Actual asynchronous hook tests cover out-of-order completion; obsolete scorer-only tests are removed or replaced.
